name: Garrovillas de Alconétar (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of blue, white, blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:1:2:1:1 with a red triangle at the hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Garrovillas de Alconétar (a broken bridge above waves and a tower).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially in 2000 (Diario Oficial de Extremadura no. 80 of 11 July 2000 and no. 94 of 12 August 2000); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of five horizontal stripes in the proportions 1/6, 1/6, 1/3, 1/6 and 1/6 of the width, with the municipal arms in its colours at the centre.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
